blockingFindings.description: The sharp shorts knee flares recorded for V78 are no longer visible in sit.png or crouch.png after restoring the moderate 8%-to-82% weight field and adding the bilateral centerline blend. This only resolves that observed artifact; upper-thigh coverage and avatar fit remain unaccepted.

The sit and crouch renders still show broad anterior-thigh exposure. A side panel lifts into a dense accordion strip with pointed, separated tabs in both poses, so the overskirt does not maintain continuous front coverage.

Front, left and back standing views retain pronounced side ridges and an uneven, long center drop rather than a coherent short overskirt silhouette. Astra independently confirmed that the skirt panel/lift behavior and hem silhouette remain release-blocking.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
